changes.reason: s0488 explicitly introduces Ma Ji as the grand administrator making the notice; his speech runs through the proposed shrine in s0491, and s0492 names Jun accepting it. That living exchange follows s0487 永和元年 and precedes Jun’s death in s0493, echoed by 父卒 before Chonghua’s 永和二年 accession in s0498–s0499. These are event-specific anchors for the existing onOrAfter AD345/onOrBefore AD346 enclosure, not an inferred Ma Ji lifespan. Preserve the mountain citation and speech identity without attaching the exact earlier Yonghe1 year to the notice or converting Jun’s reign duration into a new death year.

The current narrative supports the existing366–376 enclosure between the named Taihe opening and Taiyuan1 heading s0787, without selecting the campaign’s retained competing367/368 witnesses. s0770 returns to a general accession summary and s0778 plans a 六年夏 action; neither is treated as Dahuai’s investiture year or used for an unproved narrower endpoint.

Han Pu is claim owner p133 and personally leads the strike; this is not merely Zhang Mao’s appointment date transferred to an unrelated person. The Mao heading and post-太興三年 current-rule context distinguish the new named-era strike from the earlier 明年 defence and 未幾 terrace episode. Preserve the existing onOrAfter AD322 floor, retaining 初 rather than closing Yongchang1. The subsequent disputed 太寧三年 death/duration notices are read but remain separate untouched research holds, not an imported endpoint.
